_doc: 藥物頁人工查核紀錄（單一真實來源；2026-11-12 建，核心流程比照 TwTxGNN docs/_data/drug_reviews.json，欄位相同）。每筆＝一次查核：drug／file／claim（頁面原句）／replacement（更正後）／note（頁面上顯示的本站語言說明）／finding（內部查證結論）／sources（網址＋查閱日）／checked（查核日）／action（correct 更正｜annotate 加註｜rereview 待重審｜section 附來源段落｜rereview_result 重審結果｜header_level｜description_level）。由 scripts/apply_drug_reviews.py 套到 docs/_drugs/*.md；改寫頁面的程式結尾都會重套，scripts/check_seo_docs.py 第 17 項擋未套用的紀錄。原則：基本事實照主管機關資料更正；模型預測原文不刪不改寫，只加註；證據等級與決策只在重審結果為降級、升級或撤回時更新。2026-10-31、11-05～06 依成分重建許可證後直接刪掉的矛盾子句，2026-11-12 由 scripts/reviews_from_edits.py 依 git 前後版本轉入（id 以 <站碼>-lic- 開頭）；報告在 11 月經 AI 重產、原句已不在頁面的標 status=resolved_by_regeneration。同 id 重發時前版存進 history（retired、reason），不覆蓋丟棄。

records.claim: The "Marketed" status for South Africa should therefore be verified.
records.note: The Medicines Control Council resolved at its meeting of 14–15 April 2011 to withdraw all dextropropoxyphene-containing medicines from the South African market because of cardiac safety risks (named products: Distalgesic, Doloxene, Doloxene Co-65, Doxyfene, Lentogesic and Synap Forte), with a three-month transition period (MCC media statement, 3 May 2011). The four registrations in this data that appear only in the Medicine Price Registry and not on the SAHPRA register (Distalgesic E/2.8/0090, Doloxene Plain B0586, Doloxene Co-65 B0584, Lentogesic B1334 (Act 101/1965)) are therefore shown as withdrawn. The SAHPRA medicine register (product table retrieved 2026-11-17) still lists Doxyfene E/2.9/97 and Synap Forte J/2.8/252 as Registered and Lentogesic B1334 and Zomax B0882 as Old Medicine; the overview counts follow the SAHPRA register for those, and no SAHPRA cancellation notice was found for them.
records.finding: 2026-11-18 用戶決定：MPR 仍列、SAHPRA 不列的 dextropropoxyphene 產品加人工確認表（license_adapter.ZA_WITHDRAWN）寫成已撤市；依據 gov.za MCC 2011-05-03 媒體聲明（全部 DPP 藥品撤出南非市場）。原句說南非「Marketed」狀態待確認，不是錯句，加註 MCC 決議；SAHPRA 註冊表仍列 Registered／Old Medicine 的 4 張照 SAHPRA 不改（跟 MCC 2011 決議有出入，沒有取得 SAHPRA 撤銷文件）。
